paragraphs.opening:
Dear Director of Hearings,

I am writing under 106 CMR 343 to request a fair hearing on the denial of my SNAP recertification, which I received on {{denialDate}}. I believe the denial was procedurally improper for the reasons set out below and ask that my benefits be reinstated pending the hearing under 106 CMR 343.310.
paragraphs.missedInterview: The denial cites my failure to appear at the scheduled eligibility interview. I respectfully disagree that this is a valid basis for denial of recertification under federal regulations. 7 CFR 273.2(e)(3) requires the Department to schedule another interview on my request and prohibits denial for failure to appear without first allowing the household an opportunity to be interviewed. I am willing and available to complete an interview at the Department's convenience.
paragraphs.missingDocuments: The denial cites my failure to provide one or more requested verifications. I respectfully ask the Department to distinguish between a household's failure to provide verification and refusal to cooperate, as required by 7 CFR 273.2(d)(1). Failure alone — including delays caused by mail issues, work hours, or third-party document-issuance timelines — is not a valid basis for procedural denial without first giving me an opportunity to explain and to produce the verification.
paragraphs.noResponse: The denial cites my failure to respond to a Department request. I respectfully ask the Department to verify that the request was issued in accordance with 7 CFR 273.13 (notice requirements), including a current and accurate mailing address on file. If the Department's request did not reach me, I have not failed to cooperate within the meaning of 7 CFR 273.2(d).
paragraphs.otherProcedural: I believe the denial was procedurally improper. I am requesting a fair hearing so that the basis for the denial can be reviewed against the procedural protections of 7 CFR 273.2 and 106 CMR 343.
paragraphs.failureVsRefusalArgument: Federal regulation 7 CFR 273.2(d) explicitly distinguishes a household's failure to cooperate — which alone is not grounds for denial — from refusal to cooperate, which requires an affirmative act demonstrating the household will not take steps it can take to complete the application process. I have not refused to cooperate with the Department. I am ready to complete any step the Department requires to continue my benefits.
paragraphs.closing: I ask that the Department review this denial against the standards of 7 CFR 273.2 and 106 CMR 343 and that my SNAP benefits be reinstated pending the hearing under 106 CMR 343.310. I can be reached at {{claimantPhone}} or {{claimantEmail}}.
